app.name: MediConnect AI
app.tagline: Clinic management and informational care navigation

landing.heroTitle: Better care coordination for private clinics in Jordan
landing.heroSubtitle: Appointments, medical records, prescriptions and an informational AI symptom assistant — bilingual and accessible.

assistant.title: Symptom information assistant
assistant.consentBody: This assistant provides general health information and helps you decide what kind of care may be appropriate. It does not diagnose conditions and does not prescribe medication. To continue, please consent to processing the symptoms you describe.
assistant.disclaimerShort: Informational only — not a diagnosis and not a prescription.

emergency.title: This may be an emergency
emergency.body: Based on what you described, please seek immediate help. Call emergency services (911 in Jordan) or go to the nearest emergency department now.

aiDisclaimer.title: About the AI symptom assistant
aiDisclaimer.point1: It provides information and care-navigation support only.
aiDisclaimer.point3: It never prescribes or recommends specific medication.
aiDisclaimer.point4: Emergency warning signs will interrupt the chat and direct you to urgent care.
aiDisclaimer.point5: Any summary is reviewed by a doctor before it can enter your medical record.
aiDisclaimer.point6: You can delete your assistant conversation at any time.
